title: Iframe Resize Message Stepper
description: A child MicroSim (image area, infobox and control row) and the parent chapter page with the iframe drawn around it. Next step and Back walk the five steps of the microsim-resize protocol: default height attribute, scrollHeight measurement, postMessage, event.source matching and the height change. A Mode radio compares a fixed height, a runtime message without pinning and a runtime message with a pinned infobox; changing the callout shows clipping, jumps or stable controls.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Educational Technology
Web Development
MicroSim Engineering
Iframe Heights

educational.audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners
educational.topic: The iframe auto-height protocol and overlay height pinning
learningObjectives: The learner will differentiate the outcomes of a fixed iframe height, a runtime resize message, and a pinned infobox, by stepping through the protocol and observing where the controls land.
prerequisites: Iframe height and the CANVAS_HEIGHT + 2 rule (Chapter 12)

accessibility.notes: describe() provides a screen-reader description; all controls are native HTML elements.

controls.label: Message list
controls.action: Show the fields of a received message

assumptions: Default height attribute 402 px; the image area and control row have constant heights.
limitations: Sandboxed iframes, cross-origin targets and ResizeObserver timing are described, not simulated.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Step-through comparison of three designs on the same content
keyQuestions: Which window measures, and which window resizes the iframe?
Why does the listener compare event.source instead of the iframe src?
What does pinning cost, and what does it buy?
commonMisconceptions: An iframe grows to fit its content by itself.
Sending the message is enough; no code on the parent is needed.
Re-measuring on every change is always best.
assessmentOpportunities: The learner completes a table of iframe height and controls position for the three modes and two callouts.
The learner explains why pinning trades whitespace for stable controls.
